info.name: IRoute — Driver Empty Move Flow
info.description:
EMPTY MOVE FLOW — PCS §G (3 steps: Start Job → Departure → End Job)

NO NEW API — same endpoints; response contract for addresses:
  • Start Job UI → job.pickup_address (from_address, from GPS)
  • End Job UI → job.delivery_address / job.drop_address (to_address, NEW arrival GPS)
  • Do NOT copy pickup_address into End Job
  • After Departure: delivery_address appears (awaiting_arrival_gps until End Job execute)

PATH:
  01 Login → 02b-live Create (reason + departure GPS + from_address only)
  → 03 Job Detail → 04 Step1 → 05 Step2 → 05b Refresh → 06 Step3 (delivery GPS + location_address)

Action codes from workflow_status only — never hardcode OA-0014 etc.

Set collection variables: driver_email, driver_password, tenant_id, base_url.

request.description:
EMAIL LOGIN — Use this OR Request 01b for phone login.
Only run one login request per session.

STEP 1 — SAME LOGIN AS JOB FLOW.
Send email, password, tenant_id.
access_token is auto-saved.
Token key in response is data.access_token.
Use Authorization: Bearer {{access_token}} for all subsequent calls.
Set driver_email in collection variables before running.

Alternative body (phone login — use Request 01b instead):
{
  "extension": "{{driver_extension}}",
  "phone": "{{driver_phone}}",
  "password": "{{driver_password}}",
  "tenant_id": "{{tenant_id}}"
}

exec: pm.test("Login successful, token saved", function() { pm.expect(resp.status).to.eql(1); });
pm.test("Login FAILED — check credentials", function() { pm.expect(resp.status).to.eql(1); });

request.description:
ALTERNATIVE LOGIN — USE PHONE NUMBER INSTEAD OF EMAIL.

Use this request if the driver does not have an email
or prefers to login with phone number.

Required fields:
  extension = country code e.g. +966 or +91
  phone = phone number without extension e.g. 987456321
  password = driver password

Set driver_extension and driver_phone in
collection variables before running.

Same response as email login.
access_token is auto-saved after success.

Only run ONE login request (01 or 01b).
Both save the same access_token variable.

formdata.value: Truck breakdown during return empty move

request.description:
OPTIONAL — REPORT AN ISSUE DURING EMPTY MOVE.
shipment_id is null for empty moves (no shipment attached).
issue_type values: delay, vehicle_breakdown, customer_unavailable,
  payment_dispute, pod_issue, accident, route_blocked, other
severity values: low, medium, high, critical
vehicle_breakdown is the most common issue during empty moves.
This does NOT stop or cancel the empty move automatically.
Ops supervisor receives the report and follows up.
